# Pass One — Theoretical File Map

The Awtsmoos conceals the path until the vessels are revealed;
No guessed filename shall be changed before the tree itself is unsealed.

## Likely responsibilities, not yet asserted paths
- Shared movie schema/types/defaults.
- Shared timeline evaluator.
- Shared easing/interpolation.
- Shared action/keyframe normalizer.
- Shared feature/capability registry.
- Shared sample movie data.
- 2D renderer adapter and 2D primitive factories.
- 3D renderer adapter and 3D primitive factories.
- Mobile-first transport/editor controls.
- App-specific entry modules that preserve route identity.
- Validation/tests for schema, timing, renderer interpretation, mobile layout.
- Showcase movie data split by acts/scenes to keep files small.

## Rule
This is a responsibility map only. Actual file paths will be selected only after repository inspection, import tracing, route tracing, and runtime evidence.
